LanguageData.HV_Quotes_Show: Show quotes in thoughts and log
LanguageData.HV_Quotes_ShowTip: Thoughts and log entries made by a spoken line show the line itself.
LanguageData.HV_Quotes_Vanilla: Voice the game's own social interactions
LanguageData.HV_Quotes_VanillaTip: When two voiced colonists have a vanilla insult, slight, kind words, chat and so on, the mod writes the words for it. The game's own effects stay as they are.
LanguageData.HV_LogCount: {0} of {1} lines (the log keeps the last {2}).
LanguageData.HV_LogPawnGone: {0} is no longer in the game.
LanguageData.HV_Refused_not_negative: listener had nothing to be comforted about
LanguageData.HV_Refused_vanilla_interaction: the game already applied its own effect
LanguageData.HV_Refused_stack_full: the listener already has this thought
LanguageData.HV_ChronEmpty: The narrator has not written any chronicle entries yet.
LanguageData.HV_MindNoMind: The agent has not built a mind for {0} yet. It appears once the agent has run for this pawn.
LanguageData.HV_MindNoEvolvingBio: The bio has not changed yet.
LanguageData.HV_MindNotesHint: Your notes to this pawn's mind. The agent keeps them and merges them with what it writes; it never overwrites them.
LanguageData.HV_Conn_AgentNever: no contact since the bridge started
LanguageData.HV_Conn_Bind: Bind address (127.0.0.1 keeps the bridge on this machine)
LanguageData.HV_Conn_Token: Bridge token (the agent reads it from bridge.json)
LanguageData.HV_Conn_RegenWarn: This restarts the bridge with a new token. A running agent re-reads bridge.json; an agent on another machine needs the new token.
LanguageData.HV_Conn_EndpointHelp: The OpenAI-compatible LLM the agent talks to. Your endpoint is passed to the HermesVoice engine, which forwards the agent to it; the key is kept in bridge.json and the engine.
LanguageData.HV_Conn_KeyNote: The key is stored in the mod settings and in bridge.json, which only your user account can read. It is never sent through the bridge API.
LanguageData.HV_Probe_OkFixedBase: Works at {0}. The base URL was updated.
LanguageData.HV_Probe_Loading: The server is up but still loading the model. Try again in a moment.
LanguageData.HV_Probe_Slow: Works, but the reply took {0} ms. Lines may arrive too late.
LanguageData.HV_Probe_ReasoningText: Works, but reasoning text comes back in the output. Turn thinking off on the server.
LanguageData.HV_Probe_BadUrl: That is not a usable http or https URL.
LanguageData.HV_Probe_NothingListening: Nothing is listening there. Check the host, port and that the server is running.
LanguageData.HV_Probe_KeyRejected: The server rejected the API key.
LanguageData.HV_Probe_WrongBase: Wrong base URL: no /models there. Did you mean {0}?
LanguageData.HV_Probe_ModelNotFound: The server has no model called "{0}".
LanguageData.HV_Probe_Tls: TLS error: the certificate is not trusted, or the server is not speaking https.
LanguageData.HV_Probe_NotJson: The server answered, but not with an OpenAI-style JSON reply. Is this the right URL?
LanguageData.HV_Probe_Timeout: No reply in time. The server may be overloaded or still loading.
LanguageData.HV_Talk_PauseAt: Pause ambient chatter at game speed (0 = never)
LanguageData.HV_Talk_PauseHelp: At or above this speed the agent stops starting ambient conversations.
LanguageData.HV_Effects_Help: What a line can do to moods and opinions. Sizes and daily limits are fixed by the mod.
LanguageData.HV_Events_AgentUrl: Agent dial-out URL (the mod POSTs events here)
LanguageData.HV_Events_Push: Push events to that URL (they are always kept for GET /events)
LanguageData.HV_Dreams_EnableTip: A sleeping colonist may get a short surreal dream cloud drawn from the day's memories and thoughts. Needs the agent. Turning this off also stops the falling-asleep events.
LanguageData.HV_Art_EnableTip: When a colonist finishes an artwork, the engine writes a short description from the colony's history. It replaces the game's generated text on the info card; the title stays. Turn off to see the game's own text again.
LanguageData.HV_Bubbles_Colors: Give each pawn their own bubble colour
LanguageData.HV_Recap_Enable: Recap when a save is loaded
LanguageData.HV_Recap_EnableTip: After you load a save, a letter titled "Previously on ..." gives a three-line recap of the colony's chronicle. It never pauses the game.
LanguageData.HV_Adult_EnableTip: Off: romance and affection are fine, anything sexual fades to black. On: explicit sexual content between adult colonists. Never involving anyone under 18, in either setting.
LanguageData.HV_Adult_ConfirmText: Turn on adult content? This allows explicit sexual content between adult colonists; never involving anyone under 18.
LanguageData.HV_Wants_EnableTip: In quiet moments a pawn may decide to seek someone out for a chat or to keep clear of someone for a while. Only ever small social moves; anything more important interrupts them.
LanguageData.HV_Wants_AvoidHours: How long a pawn avoids someone: {0} game hours
LanguageData.HV_Thoughts_Show: Show pawn thoughts on the map
LanguageData.HV_Thoughts_ShowTip: Short thoughts appear as faint cloud balloons over a pawn who is not speaking. The full text stays in the Mind tab. Diary entries never appear on the map.
LanguageData.HV_Thoughts_Opacity: Thought cloud opacity: {0}% of bubble opacity
LanguageData.HV_Thoughts_PerPawn: Seconds between thought clouds over one pawn
LanguageData.HV_Adv_FixedToken: Fixed shared token (blank = a random token each run)
LanguageData.HV_Adv_FixedTokenHelp: Needed when the agent runs on another machine. Anyone with the token can read colony state and make pawns speak.
LanguageData.HV_Adv_DebugNeedsDev: The debug window needs development mode.
LanguageData.HV_Debug_State: Bridge: {0}. Requests waiting for the game thread: {1}.
LanguageData.HV_Debug_Stores: Op-id store: {0} remembered. Event ring: {1} kept, last seq {2}. Talk queue: {3} waiting.
LanguageData.HV_Debug_TestHelp: Queues a talk request for the pawn; the agent picks it up from GET /talk and answers with POST /say.
LanguageData.HV_Eng_AutoStart: Start the local engine with the game
LanguageData.HV_Eng_AutoStartTip: Launches (or attaches to) the HermesVoice engine when RimWorld starts. It also runs the agent, and stops when the game exits.
LanguageData.HV_Eng_SourceLocalTip: HermesVoice downloads and runs a model that fits your graphics card and memory.
LanguageData.HV_Eng_SourceOwnTip: Use any OpenAI-compatible server you already run (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, a cloud API).
LanguageData.HV_Eng_LocalNote: The engine picks how many lines can be written at once and how much each can remember, from your free graphics memory. It makes room for the game and grows back when there is room.
LanguageData.HV_Eng_NoAnswer: The engine was started but did not answer. See its log in the setup window.
LanguageData.HV_First_Text: HermesVoice can set up a local model that runs on your own computer: it checks your graphics card and memory, picks a model that fits, and downloads it. Or you can use an endpoint you already have.
LanguageData.HV_Setup_Title: HermesVoice: set up a local model
LanguageData.HV_Setup_NoGpu: No usable graphics card found: models will run on the processor, slowly.
LanguageData.HV_Setup_ImportHelp: For models that are not downloadable: type the full path of a .gguf file you already have. It is checked and copied into the engine.
LanguageData.HV_Setup_Shape: Running now: {0} lines at once, {1} memory each, {2} expert layers on the processor, {3} cache, about {4} of graphics memory.
LanguageData.HV_Fallback_DefaultNote: Smallest model: expect repeated lines and weaker understanding of what was said.
LanguageData.HV_Fallback_RowWarning: Warning: this is the smallest model, kept only as a fallback. {0}
LanguageData.HV_Fallback_ConfirmText:
This is the smallest model, kept only as a fallback for computers that cannot run a larger one. {0}
Use it anyway?
LanguageData.HV_Fallback_StatusLine: Warning: the smallest (fallback) model is in use. {0}
LanguageData.HV_Fallback_MessageText: HermesVoice is using its smallest model. Speech will be simpler and may repeat. To change it, open Options, Mod settings, HermesVoice, then "Set up / Change model...".
LanguageData.HV_Fallback_HideSetting: Don't warn about the small model again
LanguageData.HV_Camera_Tip: The camera follows the most interesting colonist on this map, like a TV director. Moving the camera yourself pauses it for ten seconds. You can also bind a key under Options, Keyboard, HermesVoice.
LanguageData.HV_Camera_AllowedTip: Shows the director camera button in the Voices window and enables its key binding.
LanguageData.HV_Camera_OnAtStart: Start each game with the director camera on
LanguageData.HV_Camera_OnAtStartTip: Off by default: a following camera is intrusive. Any camera control you use pauses it for ten seconds.
